description: This file provides utility functions for managing notes in a note-taking application, including loading, saving, creating, updating, and deleting notes using localStorage. It also includes comments on how to extend the functionality to a backend service.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from localStorage; returns an empty array if none are found or on error.

methods.name: saveNotes
methods.description: Persists the provided notes array to localStorage.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new empty note with a unique id and timestamp, not saved to storage.

methods.name: upsertNote
methods.description: Inserts or updates a note within the array, sorts by updatedAt descending, and returns the new array.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Removes a note by id from the notes array and returns the new array.
